examples.title: Metric summary
examples.description: label names the accessible group. value accepts a number or a formatted string.

examples.title: Both surfaces
examples.description: default and subtle choose the surface. Neither introduces hover movement.

examples.title: All sizes
examples.description: sm, default and lg adjust padding and value size without changing the data.

examples.title: Direction and tone
examples.description: Direction describes movement; tone describes whether it helps. Fewer missed calls can be a positive downward trend.

examples.title: Formatted values and units
examples.description: Formatted strings stay exactly as supplied. suffix appends a unit without parsing or changing the value.

examples.title: Update a real value
examples.description: Changed values settle briefly by default. animateValue=false disables it; reduced motion also skips movement.

examples.title: Supporting graphic and action
examples.description: Give a meaningful graphic its own accessible name. Children add a footer; the metric card itself remains passive.
